message.content:
**Uno – Basic Rules** | Item | Description | |------|-------------| | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (red, yellow, green, blue). Each color has numbers 0‑9 plus two each of “Skip”, “Reverse”, and “Draw Two”. There are also four “Wild” and four “Wild Draw Four” cards. | | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points over multiple rounds. Points are tallied at the end of each round. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face‑down as the draw pile.
• Turn up the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, follow its effect before play begins. | | **Gameplay** | • Players take turns clockwise.
• On your turn you may play one card from your hand that matches either the **color**, **number**, or **symbol** of the top discard card. You can also play a Wild card at any time.
• If you cannot play, you must draw one card from the draw pile. If that card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses direction of play (two players makes it a “Skip”).
• **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – Player chooses the next color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – Player chooses the next color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. (Can only be played if you have no other playable card; otherwise you’re penalized.) | | **Winning a Round** | When a player discards all their cards, they win the round. | | **Scoring** | • Add up the point values of the cards left in opponents’ hands:
 – Number cards: face value.
 – Skip/Reverse/Draw Two: 20 points each.
 – Wild/Wild Draw Four: 50 points each.
• The winner receives those points. | | **Continuing Play** | After scoring, shuffle the discard pile into a new draw pile and deal a fresh set of 7 cards to each player. The next round starts with the winner of the previous round. | | **Winning the Game** | First player to reach 500 points wins the game. | --- ### Quick Tips 1. **Keep track of the current color** – Even if the top card is a Wild, the chosen color matters for subsequent plays. 2. **Use Draw Two/Draw Four strategically** – Holding them can force opponents to draw more cards later. 3. **Watch for “Uno”** – When you have one card left, say “UNO!” before your opponent takes their turn. If you forget and someone catches you, you must draw two penalty cards. Enjoy playing Uno!
